s1.title: Don't Bother Dating Unless You're Ripped
s1.hook: If you're a little fat, women swipe left before they ever see your personality.
s1.body:
Over 70% of people are meeting on dating apps or online now, and in online dating, looks are paramount. If you look a little sloppy, especially if you're also short like me, they swipe left. They never see your personality. They never see how much money you have. Nothing matters except the way you look.

It's only once you crack into the top 10% best looking guys that women are even open to knowing who you are. I was in decent shape before, then I got in really good shape, and it 10x'd my matches.

The modern dating environment is winner take all. The guys at the top are taking everything. The bottom 80% are getting nothing.
s1.close: Leave a comment and tell me if your matches went up when you got in shape.
s1.pinned_comment: Did your matches go up when you got in better shape?
